name: semteams-svelte-ui
postCreateCommand: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends jq && npx -y playwright@${PLAYWRIGHT_VERSION} install --with-deps chromium firefox

semteams.notes: Svelte + Vite + Playwright e2e. AllowedNetwork includes 'public' because playwright browser installs + e2e against staging endpoints require outbound HTTP. 'public' admission still requires operator AllowPublicNetwork policy OR chain admission-reviewer approval.
